comments.author: jcun4128
comments.why: Example of a project built around a Kodak sensor
comments.text: I have seen some people work on a Kodak sensor and also Cine Pi's latest work with the IMX585 sensor is really amazing (4K/8K upscaled). The IMX585 sensor is expensive though compared to the HQ Cam IMX477. Here I'm using the Pi Zero 2 here so can't do 4K I believe (data lanes limit or something, also writing to SD card). Kodak sensor [VIDEO] Recent CinePi work [LINK] I'm not affiliated with CinePi I'm just amazed what you can do when you know what you're doing ha (eg. color grading)
